question: Is it possible to access to the service without a Vélo'v account ?
answer:
It is not necessary to create a Vélo'v account to access the service.

It is possible to purchase occasional formulas for 1 trip or for 24 hours at the Vélo'v stations equipped with an electronic payment terminal. (To find out the electronic payment terminals, consult the station map on the website or the official Vélo'v mobile application and apply the filter "only e-money stations")

1. Go to a Vélo'v reception and subscription terminal equipped with a payment terminal
2. Click on "Buy a plan" on the home screen
3. Choose the option of your choice: "Vélo'v 1 trip" at 1.80 euros for a single trip or "Vélo'v 24 hours" at 4 euros to perform an unlimited number of trips for 24 hours
4. Indicate the number of formulas desired (up to 5 formulas) and choose a 6-digit secret code
5. Insert your VISA or MASTERCARD and follow the instructions

The terminal will issue you as many access tickets as there are purchased subscriptions. 

With the temporaray tickets, you access to all the Vélo'v network and can unlock any bike by swiping your ticket (s) on the handlebars of a bicycle !

You can return your bike to any station. Make sure your bike is properly locked when you return it to an attachment point. A green light and a double beep should confirm the correct hanging up

question: How much is a journey ?
answer:
If you have an annual offer (Vélo'v 1 year, Vélo'v 1 year Young 14-25 years old, Vélo'v RSA), you benefit from 30 first minutes each trip, or 45 minutes free if you have also associated your Vélo'v subscription with a partner card TCL, OURA, or LPA, TRABOULE. Over the free period, journeys are billed per minute according to the following rates: 1st 1 / 2h fee: 0.10 € / min; 2nd 1 / 2h fee: 0,15 € / min; 3rd half hour pay: 0,20 € / min.

The "Vélo'v 1 Journey" offer allows for a single trip for 1.80 euros, including half an hour of use. If you keep the bike over 30 minutes, the excess is charged per additional minute according to the following tariff: 1st 1 / 2h fee: 0.10 € / min; 2nd 1 / 2h fee: 0,15 € / min; 3rd half hour pay: 0,20 € / min.

question: How to access to the service with a smartphone ?

question: How to dispute a payment?
answer:
If you have used the service recently, you may notice a debit from your bank account a few days later. This debit generally corresponds to the amount of one or more subscription packages taken out or journeys recently made.

- The subscription is paid on the day of purchase. 
- Any paid journeys are invoiced and debited within 6 days if you have bought a 1-day ticket or a 1-trip ticket, or every month if you have an annual season ticket.

To dispute a journey or a package, go to the "need help" section of your personal space and select the journey from the journeys you have made (30-day history) or go to the "my packages" section of your personal space and select the package you are disputing.

If your complaint concerns a payment made at a Vélo'v reception and subscription terminal, take your subscription ticket with you and contact the Vélo'v helpline on 01 30 79 33 40. If you have not kept your subscription ticket, please take all the information relating to the transaction with you so that we can carry out a detailed search. (date of transaction, amount, bank card debited, etc.)

question: Why departure and arrival stations are not displayed in the journey detail ?
answer: As part of its policy of protecting personal data, the Vélo'v service does not keep details of your trips: the departure station and the arrival station are deleted immediately for free trips, and are deleted after 30 days regarding the journeys that have been invoiced. This delay lets the user the necessary time to obtain detailed information on his journey and make a possible complaint to the customer service.

question: What to do in case of theft or lost of your service access support?
answer:
In case of loss or theft of your access card, you can request its immediate suspension by going to your personal space, on the website or the official Vélo'v application, in the "My plans" section and then clicking on "I lost my support" for the selected subscription.

The card will be immediately blocked, and you can choose to replace it with a new Vélo'v card for 5 euros or a partner card (Técély, LPA, Oura) to get from your operator.

While waiting to receive a new service access support, you continue to access the service with the official Vélo'v mobile application, or by entering your subscriber number and your 6-digit secret code, at a Vélo'v station

question: Why does a pre-authorisation of 150 euros appear on my bank account?
answer:
A request for pre-authorisation of 150 euros is made to your bank for the purposes of verifying the bank card, when the bank card is registered on your Vélo'v account. 

The pre-authorisation request does not constitute a debit by the Velo'v service.

It does, however, result in a provision of 150 euros being debited from your account for a period of 24 hours in general and up to 7 days depending on the banking establishment.

To unlock the lock, insert the key back into the shaft. The key retracts automatically and the handlebars unlock.

question: What is the Vélo'v rewards program ?
answer:
Vélo'v has set up a rewards program which aims to encourage certain actions in favor of the service and for the benefit of the whole Vélo'v community, and to promote active users with exclusive advantages!

How to earn rewards ?
- Rate a bike at the end of a journey : + 5 points
- Take your Vélo'v from a full station: +10 points
- Return your Vélo'V to a completely empty station: + 10 points

How do I use my loyalty points?

- Invite a friend: 50 points
- Book a bike in advance for 15 minutes: 10 points
- Pay my journeys in rewards beyond the free period: 1 cts = 2 points
(By checking in your profile / my preferences, the option "automatically use my rewards points when my trips exceed the free period")

question: What should I do if I find that my bike is faulty?
answer:
The bikes are checked very regularly by mobile mechanics, based on reports made by customers via the mobile app and preventive maintenance cycles for certain parts. They return to the workshop as soon as necessary for more extensive repairs.

Once a bike has passed through the hands of our technicians, it is marked ‘serviced’ on the mobile application. This indication disappears as soon as a customer makes a new assessment of the bike.

While the rating left by previous customers is generally a good indicator of the bike's condition, it's always a good idea to check that there are no visible defects before taking the bike out of storage.

If you notice a problem with your bike after taking it out of its attachment point, you must return it to its original position immediately and within a maximum of 2 minutes to avoid being charged for the journey.

You can report a faulty bike from the mobile application, either by clicking on the return notification received on the smartphone, or by going to the "need help" section of the mobile application, then the "other requests" section, "report a faulty bike".

question: Close his/her subscription ?
answer:
The Vélo'v subscription runs for 12 months and ends automatically on its anniversary date. 

If you have opted for automatic renewal of your subscription on its anniversary date, you can cancel it from your customer area. To do this, simply go to the "my packages" section and select the subscription package you wish to stop: the "automatic renewal" option can be activated or deactivated at any time, up to 3 days before the anniversary date.

If you have taken out a subscription by mistake on the website or mobile application and have not used the service, you have 15 days in which to request its cancellation and reimbursement. All you have to do is go to the "need help" section of the official Vélo'v mobile application, then click on "subscriptions", then "I want to cancel my subscription".

question: How to Invite a friend thanks to my Velo'v Account ?
answer:
The ‘Invite a friend’ option allows you to unlock a second bike with your smartphone in exchange for 50 Vélo'v points. 

Your guest's journey is free for the first 30 minutes with a mechanical bike or €1 with an electric bike for the first 30 minutes, then charged according to the current pricing for the 1-journey option: 1st 30 minutes: €0.10/min; 2nd 30 minutes: €0.15/min; 3rd half hour charged: €0.20/min. Maximum charge set at €50/rental.

To earn Vélo'v points, simply return your bike to a completely empty station (+10 points), or take a bike from a completely full station (+10 points).

If you do not have enough loyalty points, you can also purchase a single journey or 24-hour package from the ‘OUR PACKAGES’ section.

question: VÉLO’V 14 - 25 years annual membership
answer:
Vélo'v offers a reduced rate youth subscription for only 19.50 euros per year, payable one time on the day of subscription.

The Vélo'v 14-25 year-old subscription is available until the day before your 26'. To benefit from it, you must attach an ID when signing up for the first time.

Thanks to this formula, journeys are unlimited and free every first half hour, then cost 0.10 cts / min the first half hour, 0.15 cts / min the second half hour then 0.20 cts per additional minute in the 24 hour limit.

If you also have a TCL, OURA or LPA partner card, you have 45 minutes free for each trip instead of 30 minutes. Beyond the free period, billing per minute applies.

question: How to rent several bikes at the same time ?
answer:
To simplify access to the service, even for several, Vélo'v allows you to take several bikes at the same time.

There are two possibilities:

1 - If you do not have a Vélo'v account:
Go to a Vélo'v station equipped with a payment terminal (see the station map),
Then click on "BUY A FORMULA"
You can buy up to 5 short-term formulas at one time: either 1-way tickets at 1.80 euros (for a SINGLE trip), or 24-hour tickets at 5 euros (Unlimited and free journeys every first half -time)
At the end of the transaction, the terminal will issue you with as many service access tickets as there are subscribed formulas .

2- If you have a Vélo'v account:
In the mobile application or the website, go to the "our formulas" section, and the "Vélo'v on occasion" section
Choose the formula that suits you (1 trip or 24 hours)
When you release a Vélo'v, the application will ask you to select the valid formula with which you want to release your bike.
You can also release a bike by identifying yourself at a reception terminal with your subscription number and your 6-digit secret code

question: Why are some Vélo’v equipped with a sensor?
answer: Among the 5,000 Vélo'v in circulation, 500 are equipped with a geolocation sensor, which appeared in 2021 as part of an unprecedented experiment piloted by Grand Lyon. These sensors should make it possible to monitor journeys made with certain Vélo'v and then produce a "heat map", identifying the places where the most Vélo'v circulate. The data thus generated, which is rich in information, will enable Grand Lyon to gain a better understanding of Vélo'v flows and then adapt the network if necessary, enrich the user experience or even improve cycling infrastructure. Insofar as all trips made by Vélo'v are anonymized, this device has no impact for you: you maintain your anonymity, as well as the confidentiality of your trips. Only the movements of the Vélo'v are observed, regardless of who is driving them.

question: How do I change my subscription?
answer:
If you would like to switch from your current subscription to the new Vélo'v Plus package without delay, so that you can take full advantage of Vélo'v electric, you can do so directly from the official Vélo'v application.

You will then be reimbursed on a pro rata basis for your current subscription, then re-enrolled on the new Vélo'v Plus offer for 1 year.

question: How do I activate my Vélo’v Plus subscription as part of the Mobility Discovery Offer?
answer:
If you are eligible for the Mobility Discovery Offer, simply:
Create an account on the Vélo’v mobile app or website.
Sign up for the “Vélo’v Mobility Discovery Offer” package (available here: https://velov.grandlyon.com/fr/offers/groups/list#180), making sure to:
Attach the certificate provided by Toodego (certificate dated less than 30 days ago)
Enter the discount code mentioned on your Toodego certificate, just above the payment area.

You can then immediately enjoy your Vélo’v Plus subscription for 3 months. 

This subscription gives you access to both types of bike for 3 months and includes the use of electric Vélo’v bikes at no extra cost, up to a limit of 6 trips per day: 
• If you use a mechanical Vélo’v bike: unlimited trips with the first 30 minutes free on each trip (45 minutes if you are a TCL, LPA, Citiz, QPARK, VINCI parking or Effia Parking subscriber). 
• If you use an electric Vélo’v: 6 trips per day with the first 30 minutes free (+€1 per additional 30-minute trip, from the first minute).
Beyond that, the following rates apply, regardless of the type of Vélo’v used: 1st extra half hour: €0.10/min; 2nd extra half hour: €0.15/min; 3rd extra half hour: €0.20/min.

question: Delete an account
answer:
You can request account deletion by going to the "Profile" page of the mobile app and selecting "Delete Account" from the menu in the top right corner.

Account deletion is permanent and irreversible.

It is not possible if you have pending transactions or if you have recently taken trips that are still pending billing. Similarly, if you currently have a bike in use, you cannot delete your account. If you have pending payments, you must settle them first. If you have recently taken paid trips, you must wait until they are billed (according to your billing cycle: either 30 days from the anniversary of your annual subscription or within 7 days of purchasing a 1-trip or 24-hour pass).
